creators.name: ORLAN
creators.role: Artist working with performance, surgery, biotechnology and robotics
creators.bio: French artist known for her surgery-performances of the 1990s and later work with cell culture, avatars and robots.
creators.why: She made cosmetic surgery a public, conscious performance, asking who owns and authors the flesh.
creators.role_zh: 以表演、外科手术、生物技术和机器人创作的艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 法国艺术家，以 1990 年代的外科手术表演闻名，后来转向细胞培养、虚拟化身与机器人创作。
creators.why_zh: 她把整形手术变成公开而清醒的表演，追问谁拥有、谁书写这具血肉。

creators.name: Neil Harbisson
creators.role: Cyborg artist; co-founder of the Cyborg Foundation and Cyborg Arts
creators.bio: Artist born with achromatopsia who hears colour through an antenna implanted in his skull.
creators.why: His antenna is a long first-person case of a new sense becoming part of perception and identity.
creators.role_zh: 赛博格艺术家；Cyborg Foundation 与 Cyborg Arts 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 天生全色盲的艺术家，通过植入颅骨的天线“听见”颜色。
creators.why_zh: 他的天线是一个长期的第一人称案例：一种新感官如何成为知觉与身份的一部分。

creators.name: Moon Ribas
creators.role: Cyborg artist and choreographer; co-founder of the Cyborg Foundation
creators.bio: Catalan dancer who for years felt earthquakes worldwide as vibrations from sensors implanted in her body.
creators.why: She treats a new sense as a practice of attention and dance, not as data display.
creators.role_zh: 赛博格艺术家、编舞家；Cyborg Foundation 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 加泰罗尼亚舞者，多年来通过植入体内的传感器，以振动感受全球地震。
creators.why_zh: 她把新感官当作一种注意力与舞蹈的修习，而不是数据显示。

creators.name: Kevin Warwick
creators.role: Cybernetics researcher; Emeritus Professor, Coventry and Reading Universities
creators.bio: British engineer who had an RFID chip (1998) and then a neural electrode array (2002) implanted to connect his nervous system to computers.
creators.why: His self-experiments are the engineering baseline of the cyborg body, with little attention to how it feels.
creators.role_zh: 控制论研究者；考文垂大学与雷丁大学荣休教授
creators.bio_zh: 英国工程师，先后植入 RFID 芯片（1998）和神经电极阵列（2002），把自己的神经系统接入计算机。
creators.why_zh: 他的自体实验是赛博格身体的工程基线，但很少关注它被感受的方式。

creators.name: Viktoria Modesta
creators.role: Bionic pop artist and performer
creators.bio: Latvian-born British singer and performer who chose a below-knee amputation in 2007 and performs with designed prosthetic legs.
creators.why: She presents the prosthetic body as chosen, expressive and desirable rather than as a deficit.
creators.role_zh: 仿生流行艺术家与表演者
creators.bio_zh: 生于拉脱维亚的英国歌手与表演者，2007 年主动选择膝下截肢，以设计过的义肢登台表演。
creators.why_zh: 她把义体身体呈现为主动选择的、有表现力的、可被欲望的身体，而非缺陷。

creators.name: Aimee Mullins
creators.role: Athlete, actor and model
creators.bio: American Paralympic sprinter, actor and model, born without fibula bones, who owns many pairs of prosthetic legs.
creators.why: She speaks from inside the prosthetic body about choosing height, gait and identity with each pair of legs.
creators.role_zh: 运动员、演员与模特
creators.bio_zh: 美国残奥会短跑运动员、演员与模特，天生没有腓骨，拥有多副义肢腿。
creators.why_zh: 她从义体身体内部讲述：每换一双腿，就在选择身高、步态与身份。

creators.name: Lucy McRae
creators.role: Artist and body architect
creators.bio: Australian artist who calls herself a body architect and builds speculative devices, films and rituals for future bodies.
creators.why: Her works turn speculative body technology into felt, often tender experiences of pressure, scent and skin.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、身体建筑师
creators.bio_zh: 澳大利亚艺术家，自称“身体建筑师”，为未来的身体制作思辨性的装置、影片与仪式。
creators.why_zh: 她把思辨的身体技术变成可感受的、常常温柔的压力、气味与皮肤体验。

creators.name: Wafaa Bilal
creators.role: Artist; Professor, NYU Tisch School of the Arts
creators.bio: Iraqi-American artist whose performances expose the body to remote, networked violence and surveillance.
creators.why: He uses his own body, even surgically, to make networked distance felt as pain and exposure.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；纽约大学 Tisch 艺术学院教授
creators.bio_zh: 伊拉克裔美国艺术家，他的表演让身体暴露于远程、网络化的暴力与监视之下。
creators.why_zh: 他用自己的身体（甚至通过手术）让网络化的距离被感受为疼痛与暴露。

creators.name: Eduardo Kac
creators.role: Artist; pioneer of telepresence and bio art
creators.bio: Brazilian-American artist who made telerobotic works from the late 1980s before turning to transgenic art.
creators.why: His 1997 implant performance is an early artwork about the body entering a database.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；远程在场艺术与生物艺术先驱
creators.bio_zh: 巴西裔美国艺术家，1980 年代末起创作远程机器人作品，后来转向转基因艺术。
creators.why_zh: 他 1997 年的植入表演是关于身体进入数据库的早期艺术作品。

creators.name: Lee Bul
creators.role: Artist
creators.bio: Korean artist working across performance, sculpture and installation; her work addresses technology, gender, utopia and the body.
creators.why: Her Cyborg sculptures show the technological body as gendered, fragmented and vulnerable.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 韩国艺术家，横跨表演、雕塑与装置，关注技术、性别、乌托邦与身体。
creators.why_zh: 她的赛博格雕塑把技术化的身体呈现为被性别化的、破碎的、脆弱的。

creators.name: Mariko Mori
creators.role: Artist
creators.bio: Japanese artist whose photographs, videos and installations join technology with Buddhist and Shinto ideas of oneness.
creators.why: Wave UFO uses brainwaves to stage shared, meditative attention rather than control.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 日本艺术家，她的摄影、影像与装置把技术与佛教、神道的“合一”观念结合。
creators.why_zh: 《Wave UFO》用脑电波营造共享的、冥想式的注意，而不是控制。

creators.name: Shu Lea Cheang
creators.role: Artist and filmmaker
creators.bio: Taiwanese-American net-art pioneer whose films and installations deal with surveillance, sexuality and data.
creators.why: I.K.U. imagines orgasm as data harvested from bodies, a queer, sex-positive take on the cyborg.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、电影导演
creators.bio_zh: 台裔美国网络艺术先驱，其电影与装置关注监控、性与数据。
creators.why_zh: 《I.K.U.》把高潮想象成从身体采集的数据，是对赛博格的酷儿、性积极的诠释。

creators.name: Marcel·lí Antúnez Roca
creators.role: Artist; co-founder of La Fura dels Baus
creators.bio: Catalan artist who left La Fura dels Baus to build 'mechatronic performances' in which exoskeletons, robots and audiences control a body.
creators.why: Epizoo gives the audience his face and body to move, making involuntary movement a shared, uneasy experience.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；La Fura dels Baus 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 加泰罗尼亚艺术家，离开 La Fura dels Baus 后创作“机电表演”，让外骨骼、机器人与观众共同操控身体。
creators.why_zh: 《Epizoo》把他的脸和身体交给观众去移动，让不由自主的动作成为共同的、令人不安的体验。

creators.name: Margherita Pevere
creators.role: Artist and researcher in biological art
creators.bio: Italian artist who works with living matter, bacteria and the leaking, ageing body.
creators.why: Her biomaterial practice adds decay and bodily fluids to Donnarumma's machine bodies.
creators.role_zh: 生物艺术艺术家与研究者
creators.bio_zh: 意大利艺术家，以活体物质、细菌以及会渗漏、会衰老的身体进行创作。
creators.why_zh: 她的生物材料实践为 Donnarumma 的机器身体加入了腐坏与体液。

creators.name: Natasha Vita-More
creators.role: Designer and transhumanist theorist; former chair of Humanity+
creators.bio: American designer and writer who has proposed designed future bodies since the 1980s and co-edited The Transhumanist Reader.
creators.why: Her body-design proposals show the transhumanist view of the body as an upgradable platform.
creators.role_zh: 设计师与超人类主义理论家；Humanity+ 前主席
creators.bio_zh: 美国设计师与作者，自 1980 年代起提出被设计的未来身体，合编《The Transhumanist Reader》。
creators.why_zh: 她的身体设计方案展示了超人类主义把身体视为可升级平台的观点。

creators.name: Max More
creators.role: Philosopher; co-founder of the Extropy Institute
creators.bio: British-born philosopher who shaped modern transhumanism through the Extropian principles (1990s) and led the Alcor Life Extension Foundation.
creators.why: He states the transhumanist case for technological self-transformation that soma design must answer.
creators.role_zh: 哲学家；Extropy Institute 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 生于英国的哲学家，通过 1990 年代的“外熵原则”塑造了当代超人类主义，曾领导 Alcor 生命延续基金会。
creators.why_zh: 他阐明了以技术自我改造的超人类主义立场，身体设计需要回应这一立场。

creators.name: Manfred Clynes
creators.role: Scientist, inventor and musician (1925–2020)
creators.bio: Austrian-born scientist at Rockland State Hospital who studied the dynamics of emotion (sentics) and co-coined 'cyborg' in 1960.
creators.why: He framed the cyborg as unconscious self-regulation that would free a person to feel and create.
creators.role_zh: 科学家、发明家、音乐家（1925–2020）
creators.bio_zh: 生于奥地利的科学家，任职于罗克兰州立医院，研究情绪的动力学（sentics），1960 年与人合创“赛博格”一词。
creators.why_zh: 他把赛博格设想为无意识的自我调节，从而让人得以自由地感受与创造。

creators.name: Nathan S. Kline
creators.role: Psychiatrist (1916–1983)
creators.bio: American psychiatrist and psychopharmacology pioneer who directed research at Rockland State Hospital.
creators.why: Co-author of the 1960 paper that named the cyborg.
creators.bio_zh: 美国精神科医生、精神药理学先驱，曾主持罗克兰州立医院的研究。
creators.why_zh: 1960 年命名“赛博格”那篇论文的合著者。

creators.name: Julian Huxley
creators.role: Evolutionary biologist; first Director-General of UNESCO (1887–1975)
creators.bio: British biologist and humanist who popularised the word 'transhumanism' in 1957.
creators.why: His short essay is the origin point of the transhumanist idea of self-directed human evolution.
creators.role_zh: 进化生物学家；联合国教科文组织首任总干事（1887–1975）
creators.bio_zh: 英国生物学家与人文主义者，1957 年推广了“超人类主义”一词。
creators.why_zh: 他的短文是“人类自主引导进化”这一超人类主义观念的起点。

creators.name: Donna Haraway
creators.role: Distinguished Professor Emerita, History of Consciousness Department, UC Santa Cruz
creators.bio: Feminist scholar of science and technology, author of A Cyborg Manifesto, When Species Meet and Staying with the Trouble.
creators.why: Her cyborg is a situated, fleshy and political body, not a mind freed from matter.
creators.role_zh: 加州大学圣克鲁兹分校意识史系杰出荣休教授
creators.bio_zh: 女性主义科学技术学者，著有《赛博格宣言》《当物种相遇》和《与麻烦共存》。
creators.why_zh: 她的赛博格是一个处境化的、有血肉的、政治性的身体，而不是摆脱了物质的心灵。

creators.name: Andy Clark
creators.role: Professor of Cognitive Philosophy, University of Sussex
creators.bio: British philosopher of embodied and extended cognition, author of Natural-Born Cyborgs (2003) and The Experience Machine (2023).
creators.why: He argues that tools and bodies form one cognitive system, the philosophical basis of the extended body.
creators.role_zh: 萨塞克斯大学认知哲学教授
creators.bio_zh: 英国哲学家，研究具身认知与延展认知，著有《天生的赛博格》（2003）和《The Experience Machine》（2023）。
creators.why_zh: 他主张工具与身体构成一个认知系统，这是“延展的身体”的哲学基础。

creators.name: David Chalmers
creators.role: Professor of Philosophy and Neural Science, New York University
creators.bio: Australian philosopher who named the 'hard problem' of consciousness and writes on virtual worlds and machine consciousness.
creators.why: Co-author of The Extended Mind.
creators.role_zh: 纽约大学哲学与神经科学教授
creators.bio_zh: 澳大利亚哲学家，提出意识的“困难问题”，也研究虚拟世界与机器意识。
creators.why_zh: 《延展心灵》的合著者。

creators.name: N. Katherine Hayles
creators.role: Distinguished Research Professor, UCLA; James B. Duke Professor Emerita, Duke University
creators.bio: American literary and media theorist of cybernetics, posthumanism and nonconscious cognition.
creators.why: She showed how cybernetics erased the body by treating information as disembodied, and argued for embodied posthumanism.
creators.role_zh: 加州大学洛杉矶分校杰出研究教授，杜克大学荣休教授
creators.bio_zh: 美国文学与媒介理论家，研究控制论、后人类主义与非意识认知。
creators.why_zh: 她揭示了控制论如何把信息当作无身体之物从而抹去身体，并主张一种具身的后人类主义。

creators.name: Rosi Braidotti
creators.role: Distinguished University Professor Emerita, Utrecht University
creators.bio: Italian-Australian feminist philosopher of nomadic subjectivity and critical posthumanism.
creators.why: She grounds posthumanism in embodied, embedded and relational subjects, against both humanist and transhumanist ideals.
creators.role_zh: 乌得勒支大学荣休杰出教授
creators.bio_zh: 意大利裔澳大利亚女性主义哲学家，提出游牧主体与批判的后人类主义。
creators.why_zh: 她把后人类主义扎根于具身的、嵌入的、关系性的主体，既反对人文主义理想，也反对超人类主义理想。

creators.name: Don Ihde
creators.role: Philosopher of technology; Distinguished Professor Emeritus, Stony Brook University
creators.bio: American philosopher who founded postphenomenology, the study of how technologies shape perception and action.
creators.why: His 'embodiment relations' describe how a tool withdraws into the felt body, the core of soma-design thinking on technology.
creators.role_zh: 技术哲学家，纽约州立大学石溪分校荣休杰出教授
creators.bio_zh: 美国哲学家，后现象学的创立者，研究技术如何塑造人的感知与行动。
creators.why_zh: 他的“具身关系”描述工具如何隐退进被感受的身体，这是身体设计思考技术的核心。

creators.name: Nick Bostrom
creators.role: Philosopher; founding director of the Future of Humanity Institute, Oxford (2005–2024)
creators.bio: Swedish philosopher of existential risk and human enhancement, co-founder of the World Transhumanist Association.
creators.why: He gives the most cited philosophical defence of human enhancement.
creators.role_zh: 哲学家；牛津大学人类未来研究所创所所长（2005–2024）
creators.bio_zh: 瑞典哲学家，研究生存风险与人类增强，世界超人类主义协会联合创始人。
creators.why_zh: 他为人类增强提供了被引用最多的哲学辩护。

creators.name: Francis Fukuyama
creators.role: Political scientist; Senior Fellow, Stanford University
creators.bio: American political scientist known for The End of History and for his critique of biotechnological enhancement.
creators.why: He is the best-known critic of transhumanism, defending a shared human nature.
creators.role_zh: 政治学家；斯坦福大学高级研究员
creators.bio_zh: 美国政治学家，以《历史的终结》及对生物技术增强的批评闻名。
creators.why_zh: 他是最知名的超人类主义批评者，捍卫共同的人性。

creators.name: Michael Sandel
creators.role: Professor of Government, Harvard University
creators.bio: American political philosopher who teaches the course Justice and served on the US President's Council on Bioethics.
creators.why: His ethic of 'giftedness' asks designers to value what the body is given, not only what it can be made to do.
creators.role_zh: 哈佛大学政府学教授
creators.bio_zh: 美国政治哲学家，讲授“公正”课程，曾任美国总统生命伦理委员会成员。
creators.why_zh: 他的“天赋”伦理请设计者珍视身体被给予的东西，而不只是它能被改造成什么。

creators.name: Bernard Stiegler
creators.role: Philosopher (1952–2020); founder of the Institut de recherche et d'innovation, Centre Pompidou
creators.bio: French philosopher of technics, memory and attention, author of the Technics and Time series.
creators.why: He argues the human has always been technical: there is no pure, unaugmented body to return to.
creators.role_zh: 哲学家（1952–2020）；蓬皮杜中心研究与创新研究所创始人
creators.bio_zh: 法国技术、记忆与注意力哲学家，著有《技术与时间》系列。
creators.why_zh: 他主张人从来就是技术性的：不存在一个可以回归的、纯粹未经增强的身体。

creators.name: Hans Moravec
creators.role: Roboticist; former Research Professor, Robotics Institute, Carnegie Mellon University
creators.bio: Austrian-born roboticist known for Moravec's paradox and for predicting that human minds could be transferred into robots.
creators.why: His mind-uploading scenario is the clearest dualist position that soma design argues against.
creators.role_zh: 机器人学家；卡内基梅隆大学机器人研究所前研究教授
creators.bio_zh: 生于奥地利的机器人学家，以“莫拉维克悖论”及预言人类心灵可转移到机器人中闻名。
creators.why_zh: 他的“心灵上传”设想是身体设计所反对的最清晰的二元论立场。

creators.name: Vivian Sobchack
creators.role: Professor Emerita of Film, Television and Digital Media, UCLA
creators.bio: American film and media theorist who brought existential phenomenology to film and wrote about living with her own prosthetic leg.
creators.why: She writes about prosthesis from inside a body that uses one, correcting abstract cyborg talk.
creators.role_zh: 加州大学洛杉矶分校电影、电视与数字媒体荣休教授
creators.bio_zh: 美国电影与媒介理论家，把存在主义现象学引入电影研究，并写下自己与义肢共同生活的经验。
creators.why_zh: 她从一个使用义肢的身体内部来书写义体，纠正抽象的赛博格话语。

creators.name: Laura Forlano
creators.role: Professor of Art + Design and Communication Studies, Northeastern University
creators.bio: American design researcher and writer on disability, feminist technoscience and living with an automated insulin system.
creators.why: She writes the disabled cyborg body in the first person, as care, labour and exhaustion.
creators.role_zh: 美国东北大学艺术与设计、传播学教授
creators.bio_zh: 美国设计研究者与作者，研究残障、女性主义技术科学，以及与自动胰岛素系统共同生活。
creators.why_zh: 她以第一人称书写残障的赛博格身体：它是照护、劳动与疲惫。

creators.name: Allucquére Rosanne Stone
creators.role: Media theorist and artist; Professor Emerita, University of Texas at Austin
creators.bio: American media theorist, performance artist and a founder of transgender studies (also known as Sandy Stone).
creators.why: She insisted that the body does not disappear in virtual space and that virtual worlds rest on physical bodies.
creators.role_zh: 媒介理论家与艺术家；得克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校荣休教授
creators.bio_zh: 美国媒介理论家、行为艺术家，跨性别研究的奠基者之一（又名 Sandy Stone）。
creators.why_zh: 她坚持身体不会在虚拟空间中消失，虚拟世界始终建立在物理身体之上。

creators.name: Francesca Ferrando
creators.role: Philosopher; Clinical Associate Professor, New York University
creators.bio: Italian philosopher who distinguishes philosophical posthumanism from transhumanism and teaches the posthuman.
creators.why: She gives a clear map of posthuman positions, separating embodied posthumanism from enhancement programmes.
creators.role_zh: 哲学家；纽约大学临床副教授
creators.bio_zh: 意大利哲学家，区分哲学后人类主义与超人类主义，讲授“后人类”课程。
creators.why_zh: 她清晰地梳理了后人类的各种立场，把具身的后人类主义与增强计划区分开。

works.title: Suspensions
works.description: Between 1976 and 1988 Stelarc hung his body 25 times from hooks through the skin, over rocks, the sea, a New York street and a Copenhagen square.
works.description_zh: 1976 至 1988 年间，Stelarc 用穿过皮肤的钩子悬吊自己的身体 25 次，地点有礁石、海边、纽约街道和哥本哈根广场。
works.idea_en: Before any robot, his cyborg work started with the felt limits of skin, weight and gravity; he called the body 'obsolete' while testing it from inside.
works.idea_zh: 在任何机器人出现之前，他的赛博格创作始于皮肤、重量与重力被感受到的极限；他一边称身体“过时”，一边从内部检验它。
works.method: Steel hooks pierced the skin and were tied to ropes and pulleys; in some events amplified heartbeat and muscle (EMG) sounds made the stretched body audible.
works.method_zh: 钢钩穿过皮肤，连接绳索和滑轮；部分场次放大了心跳和肌电声音，让被拉伸的身体变得可听。

works.title: Stomach Sculpture
works.description: A small gold, silver and steel capsule was pushed down Stelarc's oesophagus into his stomach, where it opened, extended, flashed and beeped while an endoscope filmed it.
works.description_zh: 一个金、银和钢制的小胶囊经食道被送入 Stelarc 的胃里，在那里展开、伸缩、闪光并发出声响，由内窥镜拍摄。
works.idea_en: It turns the hidden inside of the body into a site for art, but the inside is felt only as strain and risk; inner sensation stays mute on camera.
works.idea_zh: 它把身体隐藏的内部变成艺术的场地，但这内部只被感受为紧绷与风险；内在感觉在镜头前依然沉默。
works.method: A servo-driven worm-screw mechanism of biocompatible metals was inserted 40 cm into the inflated stomach and filmed with a medical endoscope over two days.
works.method_zh: 由生物相容金属制成、伺服电机驱动的蜗杆机构被送入充气后的胃中约 40 厘米，用医用内窥镜在两天内拍摄。

works.title: Exoskeleton
works.description: Stelarc stands on a six-legged pneumatic walking machine and steers it with arm gestures while its legs, sounds and his amplified body make a noisy choreography.
works.description_zh: Stelarc 站在一台六足气动行走机器上，用手臂动作操控它；机器的腿、声音和他被放大的身体构成一段嘈杂的编舞。
works.idea_en: Steering a much larger body shows how a new body schema forms: small gestures come to feel like steps of six legs.
works.idea_zh: 操控一个大得多的身体，让人看到新的身体图式如何形成：细小的手势逐渐被感受为六条腿的步伐。
works.method: Arm gestures, read by sensors on an upper-body exoskeleton, drive a pneumatic hexapod with ripple or tripod gaits; the left arm ends in an 11-degree-of-freedom pneumatic manipulator, and the machine's sounds are amplified.
works.method_zh: 上身外骨骼上的传感器读取手臂动作，驱动一台以波浪或三足步态行走的气动六足机器；左臂延伸为具有 11 个自由度的气动机械手，机器的声音被放大。

works.title: Ear on Arm
works.description: After years of planning, surgeons grew an ear-shaped scaffold under the skin of Stelarc's left forearm; it is meant eventually to carry a microphone streaming what it hears online.
works.description_zh: 经过多年筹划，外科医生在 Stelarc 左前臂的皮下培育出一个耳朵形状的支架；最终设想是在其中放入麦克风，把它“听到”的声音在线传播。
works.idea_en: An extra organ can be grown into the body, but living with it is slow and fragile: infection, healing and skin decide the work as much as the idea.
works.idea_zh: 一个额外的器官可以长进身体，但与它共存缓慢而脆弱：感染、愈合与皮肤和想法本身一样决定着这件作品。
works.method: A porous biopolymer scaffold was implanted under the skin in staged surgeries so tissue and blood vessels could grow into it; a microphone was tested and removed after infection.
works.method_zh: 分阶段手术把多孔生物聚合物支架植入皮下，让组织和血管长入其中；曾测试植入麦克风，因感染而取出。

works.title: Eyeborg (Cyborg Antenna)
works.description: Neil Harbisson, born unable to see colour, wears an antenna implanted in his skull that turns the colours in front of him into tones he hears through bone.
works.description_zh: 天生无法看见颜色的 Neil Harbisson 戴着一根植入颅骨的天线，把眼前的颜色转成他通过骨传导听到的音调。
works.idea_en: After years of wearing it, colour-tones stopped being a translation and became perception, even in dreams; a new sense becomes part of the self, not an add-on.
works.idea_zh: 戴了多年之后，颜色音调不再是翻译，而成了知觉本身，甚至出现在梦里；新感官成为自我的一部分，而不是附加物。
works.method: A head-mounted camera sensor on an osseointegrated antenna maps light frequency to sound frequency and transmits it by bone conduction; it also receives colours over the internet.
works.method_zh: 骨整合天线上的摄像传感器把光的频率映射为声音频率，通过骨传导传给他；天线也能经互联网接收颜色。

works.title: Seismic Sense / Waiting for Earthquakes
works.description: Sensors implanted in Moon Ribas's feet vibrated whenever an earthquake happened anywhere on Earth; in Waiting for Earthquakes she stands still and dances each tremor as it arrives.
works.description_zh: 植入 Moon Ribas 双脚的传感器会在地球任何地方发生地震时振动；在《Waiting for Earthquakes》中她静静站立，随每次震动到来而起舞。
works.idea_en: The sense ties her body to the planet's movement: a steady, low background feeling that she learns to attend to, like breath.
works.idea_zh: 这种感官把她的身体与地球的运动相连：一种持续而低沉的背景感受，她学会去留意它，如同留意呼吸。
works.method: Online seismograph data drove vibration implants (first in the elbow, later the feet), with intensity scaled to magnitude; the performance lasts as long as the quakes do.
works.method_zh: 在线地震仪数据驱动振动植入物（先在手肘，后在双脚），强度随震级变化；表演时长取决于地震本身。

works.title: The Reincarnation of Saint-ORLAN
works.description: In nine surgery-performances (1990–1993) ORLAN had her face reshaped under local anaesthesia while reading texts, directing the scene and broadcasting it live.
works.description_zh: 在九场手术表演（1990–1993）中，ORLAN 在局部麻醉下接受面部改造，同时朗读文本、指挥现场并进行直播。
works.idea_en: Staying awake and speaking during surgery refuses the split between a passive body and a watching mind: she is author and material at once.
works.idea_zh: 在手术中保持清醒并说话，拒绝“被动的身体”与“旁观的心灵”的分裂：她同时是作者与材料。
works.method: Cosmetic surgeons operated under local anaesthesia in costumes she designed; the operations were filmed, and Omnipresence (1993) was broadcast by satellite to galleries.
works.method_zh: 整形外科医生在局部麻醉下为她手术，身穿她设计的服装；手术被拍摄，《Omnipresence》（1993）通过卫星直播到多家画廊。

works.title: Project Cyborg
works.description: Kevin Warwick had an RFID chip implanted in 1998 and a 100-electrode array wired into his arm's median nerve in 2002, letting him move a robot hand and feel pulses from his wife's implant.
works.description_zh: Kevin Warwick 于 1998 年植入 RFID 芯片，2002 年又把 100 电极阵列接入手臂的正中神经，借此操控机械手，并感受来自妻子植入物的脉冲。
works.idea_en: The most striking result was felt, not technical: a nerve-to-nerve signal between two people, an early and crude form of shared bodily sensation.
works.idea_zh: 最动人的结果是被感受到的，而非技术性的：两人之间神经对神经的信号，一种早期而粗糙的共享身体感觉。
works.method: A Utah microelectrode array in the median nerve recorded and stimulated neural signals, linked over the internet to a robot hand and to electrodes in Irena Warwick's arm.
works.method_zh: 植入正中神经的犹他微电极阵列记录并刺激神经信号，经互联网连接到机械手和 Irena Warwick 手臂中的电极。

paper.title: The Application of Implant Technology for Cybernetic Systems

works.title: Prototype
works.description: A music film in which Viktoria Modesta performs with a series of designed prosthetic legs, including a spike, presenting the amputee body as powerful and stylish.
works.description_zh: 一部音乐影片，Viktoria Modesta 穿戴一系列设计过的义肢（包括一根尖锥形义肢）表演，把截肢的身体呈现为有力而时尚的。
works.idea_en: A prosthesis can be felt and shown as part of one's expressive body, not as a hidden replacement for a missing part.
works.idea_zh: 义肢可以被感受、被展示为自我表达身体的一部分，而不是对缺失部位的隐藏替代。
works.method: Music video directed by Saam Farahmand for Channel 4, with prosthetic legs designed with Sophie de Oliveira Barata (The Alternative Limb Project).
works.method_zh: 由 Saam Farahmand 为英国第四频道执导的音乐影片，义肢与 Sophie de Oliveira Barata（The Alternative Limb Project）合作设计。

works.title: My 12 Pairs of Legs
works.description: In a short TED talk Aimee Mullins shows her prosthetic legs, from carbon-fibre sprinting legs to carved wooden legs, and explains how each changes her height, gait and self.
works.description_zh: 在一场简短的 TED 演讲中，Aimee Mullins 展示她的义肢——从碳纤维短跑腿到雕花木腿——并讲述每一双如何改变她的身高、步态和自我。
works.idea_en: With exchangeable legs, the body is chosen daily from inside: prosthetics can widen, not only restore, how a person can feel and appear.
works.idea_zh: 有了可更换的腿，身体每天都从内部被选择：义体不只是修复，还能拓宽一个人的感受与呈现方式。
works.method: Talk and demonstration with legs including Cheetah running blades and hand-carved wooden legs she wore on Alexander McQueen's 1999 runway.
works.method_zh: 演讲与展示，所示义肢包括猎豹跑步刀片和她在 1999 年 Alexander McQueen 秀场上穿的手工雕刻木腿。

works.title: Swallowable Parfum
works.description: A speculative cosmetic pill that would make the skin sweat fragrance, shown through images, a film and a gallery 'live lab'.
works.description_zh: 一种思辨性的美容药丸，设想让皮肤随汗液散发香味，以图像、影片和画廊中的“现场实验室”呈现。
works.idea_en: Augmentation from the inside out: the body itself becomes the atomiser, so scent follows exertion, heat and emotion rather than being applied.
works.idea_zh: 由内而外的增强：身体本身成为喷香器，香气随用力、体温与情绪而生，而不是被涂抹上去。
works.method: Developed with synthetic biologist Sharef Mansy as a design fiction; the pill is a proposal presented through photography, film and guided gallery sessions.
works.method_zh: 与合成生物学家 Sharef Mansy 合作的设计虚构；药丸是一个提案，通过摄影、影片和画廊导览体验呈现。

works.title: Compression Cradle
works.description: A person lies in a machine that slowly squeezes the whole body with a sequence of inflating volumes, like being held.
works.description_zh: 一个人躺进一台机器，机器以一系列充气体积缓缓挤压全身，就像被拥抱。
works.idea_en: Deep, even pressure calms the body; McRae asks whether machine touch could stand in for human touch in a touch-starved future, and what is lost if it does.
works.idea_zh: 深而均匀的压力让身体平静；McRae 追问在一个缺乏触摸的未来，机器的触摸能否替代人的触摸，若能，又会失去什么。
works.method: Inflatable chambers in a padded cradle inflate in a timed choreography around the lying body; exhibited at Triennale Milano.
works.method_zh: 软垫摇篮中的充气腔围绕躺着的身体按时序依次充气；曾在米兰三年展展出。

works.title: 3rdi
works.description: For about a year Wafaa Bilal had a small camera attached to the back of his head that took a photo every minute and posted it online, recording what he left behind.
works.description_zh: 大约一年里，Wafaa Bilal 的后脑装着一台小相机，每分钟拍一张照片并上传网络，记录他身后留下的景象。
works.idea_en: An eye that sees what the body cannot feel becomes a burden: his body rejected the implant, and pain ended up governing the concept.
works.idea_zh: 一只看见身体无法感受之物的眼睛成了负担：他的身体排斥了植入物，疼痛最终主导了这个构想。
works.method: A camera was mounted on a titanium plate surgically placed under the scalp; after infection and rejection it was removed and worn on a strap.
works.method_zh: 相机固定在手术植入头皮下的钛板上；因感染和排斥被取出，改用绑带佩戴。

works.title: Time Capsule
works.description: In a São Paulo gallery Eduardo Kac injected a microchip into his own ankle, then registered himself online in an animal-identification database, broadcast live on TV and the web.
works.description_zh: 在圣保罗的一家画廊，Eduardo Kac 把一枚微芯片注射进自己的脚踝，随后在网上把自己登记进动物识别数据库，并在电视和网络上直播。
works.idea_en: The body becomes a record in a database; the performance asks what happens to lived flesh once it is also an entry that others can read.
works.idea_zh: 身体成了数据库里的一条记录；这场表演追问：当活生生的血肉同时成为他人可读取的条目时，会发生什么。
works.method: A passive RFID identification chip for animals was implanted with a needle, scanned remotely over the web, and registered as both animal and owner.
works.method_zh: 用针头植入一枚用于动物的被动 RFID 识别芯片，经网络远程扫描，并以动物和主人的双重身份登记。

works.title: Cyborg series
works.description: White silicone sculptures of female cyborg bodies, headless and often missing limbs, hung from the ceiling like armour or anime figures.
works.description_zh: 白色硅胶雕塑，塑造女性赛博格身体，无头且常常缺失肢体，从天花板悬垂，像盔甲，也像动漫人物。
works.idea_en: The cyborg dream of a perfect technological body is shown as fragmented and gendered; enhancement fantasies carry old ideals of the female body.
works.idea_zh: 关于完美技术身体的赛博格梦想被呈现为破碎且被性别化的；增强幻想承载着对女性身体的旧有理想。
works.method: Cast silicone and polyurethane sculptures drawing on Japanese anime, classical statuary and mechanical armour; Cyborg W1–W4 were made in 1998.
works.method_zh: 以硅胶与聚氨酯铸成的雕塑，借鉴日本动漫、古典雕像与机械盔甲；《Cyborg W1–W4》作于 1998 年。

works.title: Wave UFO
works.description: Three visitors lie inside a large teardrop-shaped pod wearing brainwave sensors; their brain activity becomes animations on the dome above, which merge as their minds settle together.
works.description_zh: 三位观众躺进一个巨大的泪滴形舱体，佩戴脑电传感器；他们的脑活动在头顶穹幕上化作动画，并在彼此平静下来时交融在一起。
works.idea_en: Biodata is used for shared attention, close to meditation, rather than for control: three bodies lying still become one visual rhythm.
works.idea_zh: 生物数据被用于共享的注意，接近冥想，而不是用于控制：三个静卧的身体化为同一个视觉节律。
works.method: EEG sensors record alpha, beta and theta activity, and a custom game engine made at Eyebeam renders it as real-time abstract animation on the domed ceiling.
works.method_zh: 脑电传感器记录 α、β、θ 波活动，Eyebeam 制作的定制游戏引擎把它实时渲染为穹顶上的抽象动画。

works.title: I.K.U.
works.description: A Japanese sci-fi porn film in which replicant 'coders' collect orgasm data from people for a corporation that sells it as a chip.
works.description_zh: 一部日本科幻色情电影：复制人“编码者”为一家公司采集人们的高潮数据，公司再把它做成芯片出售。
works.idea_en: Pleasure imagined as extractable data: a queer, sex-positive cyborg story that also warns about the capture of intimate feeling.
works.idea_zh: 快感被想象为可提取的数据：一个酷儿的、性积极的赛博格故事，同时警示私密感受被捕获的危险。
works.method: Feature film shot in Tokyo, produced by Uplink, with a shape-shifting replicant whose arm acts as a data-collecting probe.
works.method_zh: 在东京拍摄、由 Uplink 制作的长片，片中可变形的复制人以手臂作为采集数据的探针。

works.title: Epizoo
works.description: Audience members click on a screen to move the performer's nose, mouth, ears, buttocks and pectorals through a pneumatic exoskeleton he wears.
works.description_zh: 观众点击屏幕，通过表演者身上的气动外骨骼，牵动他的鼻子、嘴、耳朵、臀部和胸肌。
works.idea_en: Being moved by strangers makes the body's boundary felt from both sides: the audience enjoys control, the performer feels intrusion.
works.idea_zh: 被陌生人牵动，让身体的边界从两侧都被感受到：观众享受控制，表演者感受侵入。
works.method: A body-worn pneumatic exoskeleton with actuators on the face and torso is driven from a computer interface with animated images of his body.
works.method_zh: 身上穿戴的气动外骨骼在面部和躯干装有执行器，由带有其身体动画图像的电脑界面驱动。

works.title: Eingeweide
works.description: Two performers become entangled on stage with an AI-driven facial prosthesis, pulsing out-of-body organs grown from microbial cultures, and animal remains.
works.description_zh: 两位表演者在舞台上与一个由 AI 驱动的面部义体、由微生物培养出的搏动的体外器官以及动物遗骸纠缠在一起。
works.idea_en: The prosthesis learns in real time how to move on the face, so the body must negotiate with it rather than command it; intimacy with a machine is felt as strain and care.
works.idea_zh: 义体在脸上实时学习如何运动，身体只能与它协商而非命令它；与机器的亲密被感受为紧张与照料。
works.method: Adaptive neural networks drive the facial prosthesis while biosensors pick up the performers' muscle sounds, which AI transforms into the score; Pevere's biomaterials leak and crawl on stage.
works.method_zh: 自适应神经网络驱动面部义体，生物传感器采集表演者的肌肉声音，再由 AI 转化为配乐；Pevere 的生物材料在舞台上渗漏、爬行。

works.title: Cyborgs and Space
works.description: The paper that coined 'cyborg': two Rockland State Hospital scientists propose altering the astronaut's body with implanted pumps and drugs so it can regulate itself in space.
works.description_zh: 创造“赛博格”一词的论文：两位罗克兰州立医院的科学家提出，用植入的泵和药物改造宇航员的身体，使其能在太空中自我调节。
works.idea_en: The first cyborg was about homeostasis handled below awareness 'leaving man free to explore, to create, to think, and to feel'; the body is changed, not left behind.
works.idea_zh: 最初的赛博格关乎在意识之下完成的体内平衡，“让人得以自由地探索、创造、思考与感受”；身体被改变，而不是被抛下。
works.method: A speculative essay built on feedback control: an osmotic pump in a rat is the working example, extended to drugs for wakefulness, radiation and emotion in astronauts.
works.method_zh: 一篇基于反馈控制的思辨文章：以植入大鼠体内的渗透泵为实例，延伸到为宇航员调节清醒、辐射与情绪的药物。

paper.title: Cyborgs and Space

works.title: Transhumanism
works.description: A short essay in which the biologist Julian Huxley proposes that humanity can deliberately transcend itself by realising new possibilities of its nature.
works.description_zh: 一篇短文，生物学家 Julian Huxley 提出人类可以通过实现自身本性的新可能，主动地超越自己。
works.idea_en: Huxley's transhumanism is about unfolding the potential of human nature, including richer experience, not about leaving the body; later transhumanism narrowed this to technology.
works.idea_zh: Huxley 的超人类主义关乎展开人性的潜能（包括更丰富的体验），而非离开身体；后来的超人类主义把它收窄为技术问题。
works.method: Essay in the collection New Bottles for New Wine (1957), reprinted in the Journal of Humanistic Psychology in 1968.
works.method_zh: 收录于文集《New Bottles for New Wine》（1957），1968 年重刊于《人本主义心理学杂志》。

paper.venue: New Bottles for New Wine (Chatto & Windus, 1957); Journal of Humanistic Psychology 8(1), 1968
paper.title: Transhumanism

works.title: Mind Children: The Future of Robot and Human Intelligence
works.description: A roboticist predicts that machines will match human intelligence and that a person's mind could be scanned neuron by neuron and moved into a robot body.
works.description_zh: 一位机器人学家预言机器将达到人类智能，人的心灵可以被逐个神经元扫描，并转移到机器人身体里。
works.idea_en: This is the plainest dualist position in the field: the mind is a pattern that can leave its flesh. Soma design answers that thinking and feeling are done by a living body, not stored in it.
works.idea_zh: 这是该领域最直白的二元论立场：心灵是一种可以离开血肉的模式。身体设计的回应是：思考与感受由活着的身体完成，而不是储存在身体里。
works.method: Book-length argument from robotics and computing trends, including the thought experiment of gradual robotic 'transmigration' of the mind.
works.method_zh: 一部基于机器人学与计算趋势的专著，包括心灵经机器人逐步“转世”的思想实验。

paper.title: Mind Children: The Future of Robot and Human Intelligence

works.title: A Cyborg Manifesto
works.description: Haraway's essay uses the cyborg, a hybrid of organism and machine, as a feminist figure that breaks the boundaries between human and animal, organism and machine, physical and non-physical.
works.description_zh: Haraway 的文章把赛博格——有机体与机器的混合——当作女性主义形象，打破人与动物、有机体与机器、物质与非物质之间的界限。
works.idea_en: Her cyborg is embodied and situated: technology is already in our flesh, so the task is to take responsibility for how bodies are built, not to escape them.
works.idea_zh: 她的赛博格是具身的、处境化的：技术早已进入我们的血肉，因此任务是为身体如何被建构负责，而不是逃离身体。
works.method: Essay first published in Socialist Review (1985) and revised as 'A Cyborg Manifesto' in Simians, Cyborgs, and Women (1991).
works.method_zh: 最初发表于《Socialist Review》（1985），修订版以《赛博格宣言》收入《Simians, Cyborgs, and Women》（1991）。

paper.venue: Socialist Review 80, 1985; Simians, Cyborgs, and Women (Routledge, 1991)
paper.title: Simians, Cyborgs, and Women: The Reinvention of Nature

works.title: Prosthetics, Robotics and Remote Existence: Postevolutionary Strategies
works.description: Stelarc's manifesto-essay argues that the human body is 'obsolete' and should be redesigned with prostheses, robotics and networks.
works.description_zh: Stelarc 的宣言式文章主张人体已经“过时”，应该用义体、机器人和网络重新设计。
works.idea_en: It treats the body as hardware to upgrade, yet his performances show the opposite: every extension had to be learned and felt from inside. Read the essay against the work.
works.idea_zh: 文章把身体当作待升级的硬件，但他的表演恰恰相反：每一次延伸都必须从内部学会、感受。请把文章与作品对照着读。
works.method: Essay in Leonardo drawing on his Third Hand, suspensions and remote-actuation performances.
works.method_zh: 发表于《Leonardo》的文章，基于他的“第三只手”、身体悬吊与远程驱动表演。

paper.title: Prosthetics, Robotics and Remote Existence: Postevolutionary Strategies

works.title: Will the Real Body Please Stand Up? Boundary Stories about Virtual Cultures
works.description: Stone studies phone-sex workers and early online communities such as CommuniTree to show how bodies and identities are built through technology.
works.description_zh: Stone 研究电话性工作者和 CommuniTree 等早期在线社区，展示身体与身份如何通过技术被建构。
works.idea_en: Against the dream of leaving the body in cyberspace, she writes that 'forgetting about the body is an old Cartesian trick': virtual life still rests on real, mortal bodies.
works.idea_zh: 针对在赛博空间中离开身体的梦想，她写道“忘记身体是一个古老的笛卡尔把戏”：虚拟生活仍然建立在真实而会死亡的身体之上。
works.method: Essay combining ethnography of early virtual communities with performance-studies analysis, published in Benedikt's Cyberspace: First Steps.
works.method_zh: 结合早期虚拟社区民族志与表演研究分析的文章，收录于 Benedikt 编《Cyberspace: First Steps》。

paper.venue: In M. Benedikt (ed.), Cyberspace: First Steps, MIT Press, 1991
paper.title: Will the Real Body Please Stand Up? Boundary Stories about Virtual Cultures

works.title: Technology and the Lifeworld: From Garden to Earth
works.description: Ihde's book describes the kinds of relations people have with technologies, starting with 'embodiment relations' in which glasses or a dental probe become part of how we perceive.
works.description_zh: Ihde 的书描述人与技术的几种关系，首先是“具身关系”：眼镜或牙科探针成为我们感知方式的一部分。
works.idea_en: A well-fitted tool withdraws into the felt body and extends it, while also amplifying some sensations and reducing others; augmentation always reshapes experience.
works.idea_zh: 一个合手的工具会隐退进被感受的身体并延伸它，同时放大一些感觉、削弱另一些；增强总会重塑体验。
works.method: Postphenomenological analysis of embodiment, hermeneutic, alterity and background relations, with historical and cross-cultural cases.
works.method_zh: 对具身关系、诠释关系、他异关系与背景关系的后现象学分析，辅以历史与跨文化案例。

paper.title: Technology and the Lifeworld: From Garden to Earth

works.title: Technics and Time, 1: The Fault of Epimetheus
works.description: Stiegler argues that the human is born without fixed qualities and has always become human through tools, writing and other external technical memory.
works.description_zh: Stiegler 主张人生来没有固定的属性，一直是通过工具、书写和其他外在的技术记忆而成为人的。
works.idea_en: There is no pure natural body that technology later augments: body and technics co-evolve, so the question is which technics care for the body-mind and which exhaust it.
works.idea_zh: 不存在一个后来才被技术增强的纯粹自然身体：身体与技术共同演化，问题在于哪些技术照料身心，哪些消耗身心。
works.method: Philosophical reading of Leroi-Gourhan's paleoanthropology, Heidegger and the Greek myth of Epimetheus; French original La Technique et le temps 1 (1994).
works.method_zh: 对 Leroi-Gourhan 古人类学、海德格尔与希腊神话中 Epimetheus 的哲学解读；法文原著 1994 年出版。

paper.venue: Galilée, 1994; English trans. Stanford University Press, 1998
paper.title: Technics and Time, 1: The Fault of Epimetheus

works.title: How We Became Posthuman: Virtual Bodies in Cybernetics, Literature, and Informatics
works.description: Hayles traces how post-war cybernetics came to treat information as separable from its material body, and how that idea shaped fiction and fantasies of uploading.
works.description_zh: Hayles 追溯战后控制论如何把信息视为可与其物质载体分离的东西，以及这一观念如何塑造小说和心灵上传的幻想。
works.idea_en: The book names the dualism in posthuman dreams and argues for a posthuman that stays embodied: information is always carried and felt by some body.
works.idea_zh: 这本书点出了后人类梦想中的二元论，并主张一种保持具身的后人类：信息总是由某个身体承载、被某个身体感受。
works.method: Intellectual history of the Macy conferences and cybernetics read alongside science fiction by Philip K. Dick, Bernard Wolfe and others.
works.method_zh: 对梅西会议与控制论的思想史研究，并与 Philip K. Dick、Bernard Wolfe 等人的科幻小说对照阅读。

paper.title: How We Became Posthuman: Virtual Bodies in Cybernetics, Literature, and Informatics

works.title: The Extended Mind
works.description: Clark and Chalmers argue that when a notebook or tool plays the role memory would play, it is part of the mind, using the example of Otto and his notebook.
works.description_zh: Clark 与 Chalmers 主张，当笔记本或工具承担了记忆本应承担的角色时，它就是心灵的一部分，并以 Otto 和他的笔记本为例。
works.idea_en: Mind is not sealed inside the skull; but the paper still speaks of cognition, not felt experience, so soma design adds the question of how an extension feels.
works.idea_zh: 心灵并不封闭在颅骨之内；但这篇论文谈的仍是认知而非感受，因此身体设计补上一个问题：延伸被如何感受。
works.method: Philosophical argument using the parity principle and thought experiments (Tetris rotation, Otto's notebook).
works.method_zh: 以“对等原则”和思想实验（俄罗斯方块旋转、Otto 的笔记本）展开的哲学论证。

paper.title: The Extended Mind

works.title: Our Posthuman Future: Consequences of the Biotechnology Revolution
works.description: Fukuyama warns that genetic engineering, neuropharmacology and life extension could change human nature and undermine equal rights, and calls for regulation.
works.description_zh: Fukuyama 警告基因工程、神经药理学与寿命延长可能改变人性、动摇平等权利，并呼吁加以监管。
works.idea_en: A critic of enhancement who defends a shared human nature; soma design shares his caution but locates what matters in lived, felt bodies rather than in an abstract essence.
works.idea_zh: 一位捍卫共同人性的增强批评者；身体设计认同他的审慎，但把重要之处放在活生生的、被感受的身体上，而非抽象的本质。
works.method: Policy-oriented book drawing on political philosophy, biology and the history of eugenics.
works.method_zh: 一部面向政策的著作，借鉴政治哲学、生物学与优生学史。

paper.title: Our Posthuman Future: Consequences of the Biotechnology Revolution

works.title: Bodies in Technology
works.description: Ihde distinguishes 'body one', the felt, moving body, from 'body two', the body shaped by culture, and asks how technologies from VR to prostheses reshape both.
works.description_zh: Ihde 区分“身体一”（被感受、会运动的身体）与“身体二”（被文化塑造的身体），追问从虚拟现实到义肢的技术如何重塑两者。
works.idea_en: Virtual and augmented bodies are never complete substitutes: the full, multisensory lived body stays the reference against which every technical body feels thin.
works.idea_zh: 虚拟的与增强的身体从来不是完整的替代：完整的、多感官的生活身体始终是参照，任何技术身体在它面前都显得单薄。
works.method: Postphenomenological essays on VR, imaging, prosthetics and the 'technology body', written for the Electronic Mediations series.
works.method_zh: 关于虚拟现实、成像、义肢与“技术身体”的后现象学文集，收入 Electronic Mediations 丛书。

paper.title: Bodies in Technology

works.title: Natural-Born Cyborgs: Minds, Technologies, and the Future of Human Intelligence
works.description: Clark argues that humans are cyborgs by nature: our brains are built to fold pens, language, tools and devices into how we think and act, no implants needed.
works.description_zh: Clark 主张人天生就是赛博格：我们的大脑天生会把笔、语言、工具与设备纳入思考和行动之中，无需植入物。
works.idea_en: Augmentation is continuous with ordinary embodiment: a new tool is incorporated by the same plastic body schema that learns a tennis racket.
works.idea_zh: 增强与日常的具身性一脉相承：新工具被纳入身体的方式，与学会用网球拍的可塑身体图式相同。
works.method: Accessible book drawing on cognitive science, neuroscience of body schema and examples from Stelarc to wearable computing.
works.method_zh: 一部通俗著作，借鉴认知科学、身体图式神经科学，以及从 Stelarc 到可穿戴计算的案例。

paper.title: Natural-Born Cyborgs: Minds, Technologies, and the Future of Human Intelligence

works.title: In Defense of Posthuman Dignity
works.description: Bostrom replies to bioconservative critics that enhanced 'posthumans' could have dignity too, and that people should be free to use technology to extend their capacities.
works.description_zh: Bostrom 回应生物保守主义批评者：被增强的“后人类”同样可以拥有尊严，人们应当有自由用技术扩展自己的能力。
works.idea_en: The enhancement view in its clearest form; it treats the body mainly as a set of capacities to raise, and says little about how an enhanced body would feel from inside.
works.idea_zh: 增强立场最清晰的表述；它主要把身体看作一组待提升的能力，却很少谈被增强的身体从内部会有怎样的感受。
works.method: Philosophical essay responding to Fukuyama, Kass and the President's Council on Bioethics.
works.method_zh: 回应 Fukuyama、Kass 与美国总统生命伦理委员会的哲学论文。

paper.title: In Defense of Posthuman Dignity

works.title: A Leg to Stand On: Prosthetics, Metaphor, and Materiality
works.description: Sobchack, who lives with an above-knee prosthesis, writes about how the leg actually feels and behaves, and criticises theorists who use 'prosthesis' as a loose metaphor.
works.description_zh: 膝上截肢、使用义肢生活的 Sobchack 写下这条腿实际的感受与表现，并批评把“义体”当作随意隐喻的理论家。
works.idea_en: The prosthetic body is lived through balance, fatigue, sound and skin; any theory of augmentation should start from that first-person material experience.
works.idea_zh: 义体身体是通过平衡、疲劳、声音与皮肤被活出来的；任何关于增强的理论都应从这种第一人称的物质经验出发。
works.method: Phenomenological essay grounded in her own experience of amputation and rehabilitation, published in the edited volume The Prosthetic Impulse.
works.method_zh: 基于她自身截肢与康复经验的现象学文章，收录于论文集《The Prosthetic Impulse》。

paper.venue: In M. Smith & J. Morra (eds.), The Prosthetic Impulse, MIT Press, 2006
paper.title: A Leg to Stand On: Prosthetics, Metaphor, and Materiality

works.title: The Case against Perfection: Ethics in the Age of Genetic Engineering
works.description: Sandel argues against enhancement in sport, parenting and genetics, saying the drive to master our nature erodes humility, responsibility and solidarity.
works.description_zh: Sandel 反对体育、育儿与遗传学中的增强，认为驾驭自身本性的冲动会侵蚀谦逊、责任与团结。
works.idea_en: His idea of the 'giftedness' of life fits soma design's attitude of appreciating the body one has before trying to fix it.
works.idea_zh: 他所说生命的“被赐予性”契合身体设计的态度：先欣赏自己拥有的身体，再考虑修正它。
works.method: Short philosophical book grown out of his work on the President's Council on Bioethics and a 2004 Atlantic essay.
works.method_zh: 一部简短的哲学著作，源于他在美国总统生命伦理委员会的工作和 2004 年发表于《大西洋月刊》的文章。

paper.title: The Case against Perfection: Ethics in the Age of Genetic Engineering

works.title: The Transhumanist Reader: Classical and Contemporary Essays on the Science, Technology, and Philosophy of the Human Future
works.description: An anthology of transhumanist writing, from Max More's principles of extropy to essays on morphological freedom, life extension and mind uploading.
works.description_zh: 一部超人类主义文集，从 Max More 的“外熵原则”到关于形态自由、寿命延长与心灵上传的文章。
works.idea_en: Read as a map of positions: some essays treat the body as a platform for a mind that could move substrates (dualist); others, like morphological freedom, keep the body central.
works.idea_zh: 可当作立场地图来读：一些文章把身体当作可更换“基质”的心灵平台（二元论）；另一些，如形态自由，则仍以身体为中心。
works.method: Edited volume of about 40 essays, including reprints of classic texts and new contributions.
works.method_zh: 约 40 篇文章的编著，包括经典文本重刊与新稿。

paper.title: The Transhumanist Reader

works.title: Primo Posthuman
works.description: A design concept for a future human body with upgradable senses, a 'metabrain', smart skin and replaceable parts, presented as images and texts.
works.description_zh: 一个未来人体的设计概念：可升级的感官、“元脑”、智能皮肤和可替换的部件，以图像与文字呈现。
works.idea_en: It shows the transhumanist image of the body as a product to redesign; the question soma design adds is who feels the upgrade and how it would be lived.
works.idea_zh: 它呈现了超人类主义把身体当作可重新设计的产品的形象；身体设计追加的问题是：谁来感受这次升级，它将如何被活出来。
works.method: Speculative design drawings and specifications drawing on nanotechnology, AI and cosmetic medicine, revised over the following decade.
works.method_zh: 思辨设计图与规格说明，借鉴纳米技术、人工智能与美容医学，在其后十年中不断修订。

works.title: The Posthuman
works.description: Braidotti sets out a critical posthumanism that moves beyond the ideal of 'Man' toward subjects that are embodied, embedded and bound up with animals, machines and the earth.
works.description_zh: Braidotti 提出一种批判的后人类主义，超越“人”的理想，走向具身的、嵌入的、与动物、机器和地球相互缠绕的主体。
works.idea_en: She rejects transhumanist escape from the body and grounds the posthuman in vital, relational matter; the body is where the subject happens, not a vehicle.
works.idea_zh: 她拒绝超人类主义对身体的逃离，把后人类扎根于有生命力的、关系性的物质；身体是主体发生之处，而非载具。
works.method: Philosophical book drawing on Spinoza, Deleuze and feminist theory, with chapters on life beyond the self, beyond species and beyond death.
works.method_zh: 借鉴斯宾诺莎、德勒兹与女性主义理论的哲学著作，分章讨论超越自我、超越物种与超越死亡的生命。

paper.title: The Posthuman

works.title: Data Rituals in Intimate Infrastructures: Crip Time and the Disabled Cyborg Body as an Epistemic Site of Feminist Science
works.description: Forlano writes in the first person about living with an insulin pump and continuous glucose monitor: the alarms, rituals and sleepless nights of a body joined to an automated system.
works.description_zh: Forlano 以第一人称书写与胰岛素泵和连续血糖监测仪共同生活：一个与自动化系统相连的身体所经历的警报、仪式与不眠之夜。
works.idea_en: The actual cyborg body is disabled, tired and caring for its machines; felt experience of living with devices is itself a source of knowledge.
works.idea_zh: 真实的赛博格身体是残障的、疲惫的、需要照料它的机器的；与设备共同生活的切身感受本身就是知识的来源。
works.method: Autoethnographic essay drawing on feminist technoscience and crip theory, based on years of her own device data and routines.
works.method_zh: 借鉴女性主义技术科学与残障（crip）理论的自我民族志文章，基于她自己多年的设备数据与日常。

paper.title: Data Rituals in Intimate Infrastructures: Crip Time and the Disabled Cyborg Body as an Epistemic Site of Feminist Science

works.title: Philosophical Posthumanism
works.description: Ferrando maps posthumanism, transhumanism, antihumanism, new materialism and related movements, and develops a philosophical posthumanism of relation and embodiment.
works.description_zh: Ferrando 梳理后人类主义、超人类主义、反人文主义、新唯物主义等思潮，并发展出一种关于关系与具身的哲学后人类主义。
works.idea_en: Useful for designers who need to tell the enhancement agenda apart from posthumanisms that keep the body and other species at the centre.
works.idea_zh: 适合需要区分“增强议程”与“以身体和其他物种为中心的后人类主义”的设计者。
works.method: Philosophy textbook-monograph in the Theory in the New Humanities series, with a glossary of posthuman terms.
works.method_zh: 收入 Theory in the New Humanities 丛书的哲学专著兼教材，附后人类术语表。

paper.title: Philosophical Posthumanism

leads.why: Speculative design of a human body gestating another species; East Asian transhuman body design.

leads.name: Mona Hatoum — Corps étranger (1994)
leads.why: Endoscopic video journey through the artist's own body; the inner body made visible by technology.

leads.name: Stelarc — Fractal Flesh (1995)
leads.why: Remote audiences actuate his muscles by touch screen and EMS; close to Ping Body (already in movement-art-2), so skipped.

leads.why: Organisation defending cyborg rights; better as a Resources entry (data/orgs) than as a work.

leads.name: Cyborg Nest — North Sense (2016)
leads.why: Implanted north-sensing vibration device; belongs to augment-hci (new-senses).

leads.name: Lepht Anonym — grinder self-implants
leads.why: DIY biohacker writing about implanted magnets and felt new senses; no stable primary source found.

leads.name: Jillian Weise — The Dawn of the Tryborg (NYT, 2016)
leads.why: Disabled poet's critique of able-bodied 'cyborg' talk; strong crip counterpoint.

leads.name: Alison Kafer — Feminist, Queer, Crip (2013)
leads.why: Chapter on the cyborg and disability politics (DOI 10.2979/6841.0).

leads.name: Laura Forlano & Danya Glabau — Cyborg (MIT Press Essential Knowledge, 2024)
leads.why: Recent short book on cyborgs from disability and feminist perspectives.

leads.why: Cosmotechnics: a Chinese-philosophy answer to Stiegler; could anchor an East Asian view of technics and body.

leads.name: David Le Breton — L'adieu au corps (1999)
leads.why: French anthropologist's critique of techno-cultural contempt for the body.

leads.why: Second mind-uploading foil; Moravec already covers the dualist position.

leads.why: AI robotic limb performing a skin-cutting ritual; more machine than felt body, skipped.
